description: Firms whose SAM.gov registration expires within the next N days (default 30), soonest first, by NAICS and state. Individuals are left out. Costs credits like the REST call. Every answer has meta.as_of (the dataset date) and a record_url to the SAM.gov or USAspending source.

naics.description: NAICS code or 2 to 5 digit prefix.

user_request.description: The current user task in one sentence. Leave out secrets and personal data.

name: expiring_registrations
